text.intro:
The rec center runs a pickleball ladder on Tuesdays. Courts go by start time, and the sign-up sheet gets rewritten more than once.
Five players are involved. Determine each player's start time, paddle and gripe.
- **Player**: Ramesh, Buzz Kovacs, Arlene, Pete Ng and Yolanda.
- **Start time** (listed from earlier to later): 8am, 9am, 10am, 11am and noon.
- **Paddle**: a carbon-fiber paddle, a bright orange paddle, a paddle with a taped grip, an oversize paddle and a hand-me-down paddle.
- **Gripe**: the noisy court next door, the sun, a bad knee, a wet court and nobody at all.
Every player has a different start time, paddle and gripe, so within each category every item is used exactly once.
clues: 10am falls somewhere between Buzz Kovacs and Pete Ng in start time order.
11am falls somewhere between the player who plays with a hand-me-down paddle and the player who plays with an oversize paddle in start time order.
The player who plays with a paddle with a taped grip and 8am are exactly one hour apart in start time order, in one direction or the other.
8am is exactly one hour earlier than the player who blames the noisy court next door, with no start time in between.
The player who blames a wet court does not play at noon.
Pete Ng does not blame the noisy court next door.
The player who plays with a paddle with a taped grip falls somewhere between Buzz Kovacs and Ramesh in start time order.
Arlene is exactly one hour earlier than the player who blames the sun, with no start time in between.
The player who plays with a hand-me-down paddle is exactly one hour earlier than the player who blames the sun, with no start time in between.
The player who blames a wet court does not play with a carbon-fiber paddle.
One of the player who blames a bad knee and Pete Ng sits at an odd-numbered start time and the other at an even-numbered start time.
The player who plays with a paddle with a taped grip is exactly one hour earlier than the player who blames nobody at all, with no start time in between.
